decisions.reason: Selecting the Business Case site list does not change the existing capex estimates, assumption basis, or shared-program capex treatment.
The selected site list does not alter the program-level opex range or its source; the source message addresses those separately.
The site-list selection does not necessarily change the modeled revenue streams, pricing basis, or documentation rule.
The model remains denominated in CAD with a 2026 price base regardless of which eight-site list is used.
Choosing the Business Case site list does not change the capital structure, financing rate, debt-tranche treatment, or refinement trigger.
The site-list decision does not modify the requirement to apply asset-specific Canadian CCA classes or model their tax effects.
The chosen network list does not alter the DSCR and equity-IRR thresholds used to size the availability payment.
The decision supplies a network-configuration input but does not change the existing obligation to document assumptions and their sources.

The Business Case is already encompassed by the supplied attachments; the site-list resolution is owned by the network-configuration Requirement and does not change the general source-verification policy.
The site-list selection leaves the user-funded and PPP scenario structure and availability-payment justification unchanged.
The selected sites do not change the required integrated three-statement structure or financial-engine basis.
The site-list decision does not add, remove, or redefine any of the specified sensitivity variables.
